backend_decision: User permits ComfyUI but does not mandate it. This run selects local ComfyUI for fixed workflow/seed/masks; any tool change must retain geometry/masks/validation and record its actual settings.

decisions.selection: One shared selection ID resolves authored small/portrait parts; no automatic shrinking
decisions.base: Bare skin-colored body, featureless pelvis; no face, hair, underwear or equipment baked in
decisions.masks: Separate ownership, skin/lacquer palette, occlusion, control/weights, joint overlap and hidden construction
decisions.safety: No native mouse tools; no cursor or OS input setting changes
decisions.preservation: No existing files deleted; main/design/foundation/Confirmed unchanged

authoring_geometry.basis: User rated appearance about 10; this generic mannequin does not correspond to original officer. No four-head anatomical target adopted.

review_policy: technical / semantic / appearance / runtime separately bound to current input, mask, tool and output hashes; no automatic visual approval

mask_roles.ownership: Unique visible source pixel owner, character-relative left/right
mask_roles.material: Recolor skin or lacquer only; preserve alpha and all other pixels
mask_roles.occlusion: Direction/phase-aware front/back relationship; independent of owner ID
mask_roles.controls: Joint/face tracking IDs and deformation weights; not source ownership
mask_roles.overlap: Declared bounded shared joint zone and allowed owner IDs
mask_roles.hidden: Unobserved drawn surface separately authored and reviewed; do not fill face using nearest neighboring pixels

layer_order_status: Per direction/pose authoring required; slots are not a universal draw order
